import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { mountChatbot } from '../templates/chat/assistant/mount.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const result = await mountChatbot(element, { i18n, inheritAppearance: true }, onError);
	return result;
}
vue
<template>
	<div @submit.prevent="controller.send()">
		<AsamBaseForm class="chat-composer"
			><p role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" class="chat-status">
				{{ phaseLabels[state.phase] }}
			</p>
			<p v-if="state.responseError" role="alert" class="chat-notice">
				{{ controller.formatError(state, 'responseError') }}
			</p>
			<p v-if="state.readonly || denied">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.readonly') }}</p>
			<p v-if="state.disabled">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.disabled') }}</p>
			<label :for="inputId">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.message') }}</label
			><AsamTextarea
				:id="inputId"
				ref="input"
				:model-value="state.draft"
				:size="size"
				:rows="3"
				resize="vertical"
				:readonly="state.readonly || denied"
				:disabled="state.disabled"
				:maxlength="12000"
				:placeholder="i18n.t('app.templates.chat.placeholder')"
				@update:model-value="controller.setDraft(String($event))"
				@keydown="keydown"
				@compositionstart="compositionStart"
				@compositionend="compositionEnd"
			/>
			<div class="composer-actions">
				<small>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.keyboard') }}</small
				><slot name="actions" /><AsamButton
					v-if="state.phase === 'responding'"
					class="chat-message-button"
					:size="size"
					type="danger"
					data-action="stop"
					@click="controller.stop()"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.stop') }}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton
					v-if="state.canRetry"
					class="chat-message-button"
					type="default"
					:size="size"
					data-action="retry"
					@click="controller.retry()"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.retry') }}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton
					class="chat-message-button"
					type="primary"
					:size="size"
					native-type="submit"
					data-action="send"
					:disabled="!state.canSend || !state.draft.trim()"
					>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.send') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</div></AsamBaseForm
		>
	</div>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamBaseForm } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'ChatMessageComposer' });
import { useChatI18n } from './I18n.js';
const i18n = useChatI18n();
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, useId } from 'vue';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTextarea } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize, AsamTextareaExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { ChatController } from './Controller.js';
import type { ChatSnapshot } from './Types.js';
const props = defineProps<{
	state: ChatSnapshot;
	controller: ChatController;
	size: AsamControlSize;
}>();
defineSlots<{ actions?: () => VNode[] }>();
const input = ref<AsamTextareaExpose>();
const inputId = `chat-input-${useId()}`;
const denied = computed(
	() => props.state.sessions.find((s) => s.id === props.state.selected)?.canSend === false
);
const phaseLabels = {
	get idle() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.ready');
	},
	get responding() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.respondingHint');
	},
	get completed() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.completedHint');
	},
	get stopped() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.stoppedHint');
	},
	get error() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.errorHint');
	}
};
let composing = false,
	justComposed = false;
let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
function compositionStart() {
	composing = true;
}
function compositionEnd() {
	composing = false;
	justComposed = true;
	clearTimeout(timer);
	timer = setTimeout(() => {
		justComposed = false;
	}, 0);
}
function keydown(event: KeyboardEvent | Event) {
	if (!(event instanceof KeyboardEvent) || event.key !== 'Enter' || event.shiftKey) return;
	if (event.isComposing || composing || justComposed || event.keyCode === 229) return;
	event.preventDefault();
	void props.controller.send();
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(timer));
defineExpose({ focus: () => input.value?.focus() });
</script>

/** All demo data is synthetic. Keep the fixed load when changing design or content. */
export const chatDemoConfig = Object.freeze({
	sessionCount: 20,
	historyCount: 60,
	readDelayMs: 100,
	deltaDelayMs: 100,
	fragments: [
		'可以把这次讨论整理为三个部分。\n',
		'一、先确认目标和约束，',
		'再整理已有的记录。\n',
		'二、把需要核实的事实单独列出，',
		'保留原始表述与上下文。\n',
		'三、按负责人和时间整理后续行动。\n',
		'下面是只读代码示例：\n',
		'```ts\n',
		'const next = items.filter(item => item.ready);\n',
		'console.log(next.length);\n',
		'```\n',
		'这些内容来自本地合成示例，请按实际资料核对。'
	] as readonly string[],
	toolText: '已整理本地示例记录，没有执行外部工具。'
});
ts
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createAsamMessageIssue, formatFieldIssue } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { chatMessageDefaults } from './I18n.js';
import { computed, shallowReadonly, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { chatKey, decodeMessages, decodeSessions, isTool } from './Protocol.js';
import type {
	ChatEvent,
	ChatId,
	ChatMessage,
	ChatOptions,
	ChatPhase,
	ChatReadContext,
	ChatResponse,
	ChatSnapshot
} from './Types.js';

type MessageIssue = ReturnType<typeof createAsamMessageIssue>;
type ErrorField = 'listError' | 'historyError' | 'responseError';
interface Attempt {
	id: string;
	userId: string;
	assistant: ChatMessage;
	tools: Map<string, ChatMessage>;
	sessionKey: string;
	controller: AbortController;
	generation: number;
	sequence: number;
	started: boolean;
	sealed: boolean;
	timer?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
}
interface Conversation {
	messages: readonly ChatMessage[];
	draft: string;
	phase: ChatPhase;
	error: string;
	errorSource?: MessageIssue;
	loaded: boolean;
	retryUser?: string;
}
let instanceSequence = 0;

/** Owns only view operations. Never disposes the borrowed service, reader or request client. */
export function createChatController(initial: ChatOptions, owner?: AsamI18n) {
	const i18n = owner ? extendAsamI18n(owner, chatMessageDefaults) : undefined;
	const sources = new WeakMap<ChatSnapshot, Partial<Record<ErrorField, MessageIssue>>>();
	let options = { ...initial };
	let generation = 0;
	let action = 0;
	let listVersion = 0;
	let historyVersion = 0;
	let disposed = false;
	let transitioning = false;
	let active: Attempt | undefined;
	let listAbort: AbortController | undefined;
	let historyAbort: AbortController | undefined;
	const namespace = `chat-${++instanceSequence}`;
	let sequence = 0;
	// Historical IDs are opaque and may contain any of our previous generated formats.
	// Reserve every accepted history and locally allocated identity, across scope/reset as well.
	const reservedIdentities = new Set<string>();
	function identity(kind: 'user' | 'attempt' | 'assistant' | 'tool'): string {
		let id: string;
		do id = `${namespace}:${kind}:${++sequence}`;
		while (reservedIdentities.has(id));
		reservedIdentities.add(id);
		return id;
	}
	function replaceOwned(row: Conversation, previous: ChatMessage, next: ChatMessage) {
		row.messages = Object.freeze(
			row.messages.map((message) => (message === previous ? next : message))
		);
	}
	const conversations = new Map<string, Conversation>();
	const state = shallowRef<ChatSnapshot>({
		scope: options.scope ?? '',
		generation,
		sessions: [],
		selected: null,
		messages: [],
		draft: '',
		listPhase: 'idle',
		historyPhase: 'idle',
		listError: '',
		historyError: '',
		responseError: '',
		phase: 'idle',
		readonly: !!options.readonly,
		disabled: !!options.disabled,
		canSend: false,
		canRetry: false,
		discardedEvents: 0
	});
	const selectedKey = () =>
		state.value.selected === null ? undefined : chatKey(state.value.selected);
	const conversation = () => {
		const key = selectedKey();
		return key === undefined ? undefined : conversations.get(key);
	};
	function publish(
		patch: Partial<ChatSnapshot> = {},
		owned: Partial<Record<ErrorField, MessageIssue | undefined>> = {}
	) {
		if (disposed) return;
		const issueSources = { ...sources.get(state.value), ...owned };
		for (const key of ['listError', 'historyError', 'responseError'] as const)
			if (patch[key] === '') delete issueSources[key];
		const next = { ...state.value, ...patch };
		const row =
			next.selected === null
				? undefined
				: next.sessions.find((s) => chatKey(s.id) === chatKey(next.selected!));
		const record =
			next.selected === null ? undefined : conversations.get(chatKey(next.selected));
		const permitted =
			!!row &&
			row.canSend !== false &&
			!options.readonly &&
			!options.disabled &&
			next.listPhase !== 'loading' &&
			next.historyPhase === 'ready' &&
			record?.loaded === true &&
			next.phase !== 'responding';
		const snapshot = Object.freeze({
			...next,
			readonly: !!options.readonly,
			disabled: !!options.disabled,
			canSend: permitted,
			canRetry: permitted && !!record?.retryUser
		});
		// Bind before publishing so synchronous readers see this snapshot's own source.
		sources.set(snapshot, issueSources);
		state.value = snapshot;
	}
	function render() {
		const row = conversation();
		publish(
			{
				messages: row?.messages ?? [],
				draft: row?.draft ?? '',
				phase: row?.phase ?? 'idle',
				responseError: row?.error ?? ''
			},
			{ responseError: row?.errorSource }
		);
	}
	function current(attempt: Attempt) {
		return (
			!disposed &&
			active === attempt &&
			attempt.generation === generation &&
			selectedKey() === attempt.sessionKey
		);
	}
	function settle(
		attempt: Attempt,
		phase: 'completed' | 'stopped' | 'error',
		error: string | MessageIssue = ''
	) {
		if (!current(attempt) || attempt.sealed) return;
		attempt.sealed = true;
		clearTimeout(attempt.timer);
		const row = conversations.get(attempt.sessionKey)!;
		const next = Object.freeze({ ...attempt.assistant, phase });
		replaceOwned(row, attempt.assistant, next);
		attempt.assistant = next;
		row.phase = phase;
		row.error = typeof error === 'string' ? error : error.message;
		row.errorSource = typeof error === 'string' ? undefined : error;
		row.retryUser = phase === 'completed' ? undefined : attempt.userId;
		// Seal before publication or abort: synchronous observers/host callbacks may reenter.
		render();
		attempt.controller.abort();
	}
	function stop() {
		if (active && !active.sealed)
			settle(
				active,
				'stopped',
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					'回答已停止，已收到的内容保留。可显式重试。',
					'app.templates.chat.stoppedError'
				)
			);
	}
	function cancelReads() {
		++listVersion;
		++historyVersion;
		const list = listAbort,
			history = historyAbort;
		listAbort = undefined;
		historyAbort = undefined;
		publish({
			listPhase: state.value.listPhase === 'loading' ? 'idle' : state.value.listPhase,
			historyPhase: state.value.historyPhase === 'loading' ? 'idle' : state.value.historyPhase
		});
		list?.abort();
		history?.abort();
	}
	function context(signal: AbortSignal): ChatReadContext {
		return { scope: options.scope ?? '', generation, signal };
	}
	async function reload() {
		if (disposed || transitioning || options.disabled) return false;
		const version = ++listVersion,
			epoch = generation,
			service = options.service;
		const old = listAbort;
		const abort = new AbortController();
		listAbort = abort;
		old?.abort();
		const valid = () =>
			!disposed && epoch === generation && version === listVersion && !abort.signal.aborted;
		if (!valid()) return false;
		publish({ listPhase: 'loading', listError: '' });
		if (!valid()) return false;
		try {
			const sessions = decodeSessions(await service.list(context(abort.signal)));
			if (!valid()) return false;
			const selected = state.value.selected;
			const retained =
				selected === null
					? undefined
					: sessions.find((s) => chatKey(s.id) === chatKey(selected));
			if (!retained || retained.canSend === false) stop();
			if (!valid()) return false;
			const selectionAction = action;
			publish({ sessions, listPhase: 'ready' });
			if (!valid()) return false;
			if (!retained && selectionAction === action) {
				if (sessions[0]) return await select(sessions[0].id);
				await select(null);
			}
			return true;
		} catch {
			if (valid())
				publish(
					{
						listPhase: 'error',
						listError: '会话列表读取失败，保留上一版本。请重试。'
					},
					{
						listError: createAsamMessageIssue(
							'会话列表读取失败，保留上一版本。请重试。',
							'app.templates.chat.listError'
						)
					}
				);
			return false;
		} finally {
			if (listAbort === abort) listAbort = undefined;
		}
	}
	async function select(id: ChatId | null, force = false) {
		if (disposed || transitioning || options.disabled) return false;
		if (!force && id !== null && selectedKey() === chatKey(id) && conversation()?.loaded)
			return true;
		const operation = ++action;
		const key = id === null ? undefined : chatKey(id);
		stop();
		if (disposed || operation !== action) return false;
		active = undefined;
		const version = ++historyVersion,
			epoch = generation,
			service = options.service;
		const old = historyAbort;
		const abort = new AbortController();
		historyAbort = abort;
		old?.abort();
		const valid = () =>
			!disposed &&
			epoch === generation &&
			operation === action &&
			version === historyVersion &&
			!abort.signal.aborted;
		if (!valid()) return false;
		if (key === undefined) {
			publish({ selected: null, historyPhase: 'idle', historyError: '' });
			render();
			return true;
		}
		if (!state.value.sessions.some((s) => chatKey(s.id) === key)) {
			publish(
				{
					selected: id,
					messages: [],
					draft: '',
					phase: 'idle',
					responseError: '',
					historyPhase: 'error',
					historyError: '会话不存在或已无访问权限，请选择其他会话。'
				},
				{
					historyError: createAsamMessageIssue(
						'会话不存在或已无访问权限，请选择其他会话。',
						'app.templates.chat.missingSession'
					)
				}
			);
			return false;
		}
		if (!conversations.has(key))
			conversations.set(key, {
				messages: [],
				draft: '',
				phase: 'idle',
				error: '',
				loaded: false
			});
		const row = conversations.get(key)!;
		publish(
			{
				selected: id,
				messages: row.messages,
				draft: row.draft,
				phase: row.phase,
				responseError: row.error,
				historyError: '',
				historyPhase: row.loaded && !force ? 'ready' : 'loading'
			},
			{ responseError: row.errorSource }
		);
		if (!valid()) return false;
		if (row.loaded && !force) return true;
		try {
			const messages = decodeMessages(await service.history(id!, context(abort.signal)));
			if (!valid()) return false;
			for (const message of messages) {
				reservedIdentities.add(message.id);
				if (message.tool) reservedIdentities.add(message.tool.id);
			}
			row.messages = messages;
			row.loaded = true;
			row.phase = 'idle';
			row.error = '';
			row.errorSource = undefined;
			row.retryUser = undefined;
			publish({ historyPhase: 'ready' });
			if (valid()) render();
			return true;
		} catch {
			if (valid())
				publish(
					{
						historyPhase: 'error',
						historyError: '历史记录读取失败，可重试。已有记录保留。'
					},
					{
						historyError: createAsamMessageIssue(
							'历史记录读取失败，可重试。已有记录保留。',
							'app.templates.chat.historyError'
						)
					}
				);
			return false;
		} finally {
			if (historyAbort === abort) historyAbort = undefined;
		}
	}
	function accept(attempt: Attempt, event: ChatEvent) {
		if (!current(attempt)) return;
		if (attempt.sealed) {
			publish({ discardedEvents: state.value.discardedEvents + 1 });
			return;
		}
		const invalid = () =>
			settle(
				attempt,
				'error',
				createAsamMessageIssue(
					'响应事件格式或顺序无效，已保留部分内容。请显式重试。',
					'app.templates.chat.invalidEvent'
				)
			);
		if (
			!event ||
			typeof event !== 'object' ||
			event.attemptId !== attempt.id ||
			!Number.isSafeInteger(event.sequence) ||
			event.sequence !== attempt.sequence + 1
		) {
			invalid();
			return;
		}
		if (!attempt.started && event.type !== 'start') {
			invalid();
			return;
		}
		attempt.sequence = event.sequence;
		const row = conversations.get(attempt.sessionKey)!;
		switch (event.type) {
			case 'start':
				if (attempt.started) {
					invalid();
					return;
				}
				attempt.started = true;
				break;
			case 'text-delta':
				if (typeof event.text !== 'string') {
					invalid();
					return;
				}
				{
					const next = Object.freeze({
						...attempt.assistant,
						text: attempt.assistant.text + event.text
					});
					replaceOwned(row, attempt.assistant, next);
					attempt.assistant = next;
				}
				break;
			case 'tool-state': {
				if (!isTool(event.tool)) {
					invalid();
					return;
				}
				const previous = attempt.tools.get(event.tool.id);
				const id = previous?.id ?? identity('tool');
				const tool: ChatMessage = Object.freeze({
					id,
					role: 'tool',
					text: event.tool.text,
					tool: Object.freeze({ ...event.tool }),
					attemptId: attempt.id,
					replyTo: attempt.userId
				});
				attempt.tools.set(event.tool.id, tool);
				if (previous) replaceOwned(row, previous, tool);
				else row.messages = Object.freeze([...row.messages, tool]);
				break;
			}
			case 'complete':
				settle(attempt, 'completed');
				return;
			case 'error':
				if (!['unavailable', 'denied'].includes(event.code)) {
					invalid();
					return;
				}
				settle(
					attempt,
					'error',
					event.code === 'denied'
						? createAsamMessageIssue(

										? message.tool?.name
										: i18n.t('app.templates.chat.assistant')
							}}</strong
							><span v-if="message.role === 'tool' && message.tool"
								>{{ toolLabels[message.tool.state] }} ·
								{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.toolReadonly') }}</span
							><span v-else-if="message.phase">{{ phaseLabels[message.phase] }}</span>
						</header>
						<pre>{{

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useChatI18n } from './I18n.js';
const i18n = useChatI18n();
import { nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { ChatController } from './Controller.js';
import type { ChatSnapshot, ChatMessage } from './Types.js';
import { chatKey } from './Protocol.js';
const props = defineProps<{
	state: ChatSnapshot;
	controller: ChatController;
	size: AsamControlSize;
}>();
defineSlots<{
	message?: (props: { message: ChatMessage }) => VNode[];
	empty?: (props: { selected: boolean }) => VNode[];
}>();
const viewport = ref<HTMLElement>();
const unread = ref(false);
let near = true,
	serial = 0,
	alive = true,
	restoring = false;
const positions = new Map<string, number>();
const phaseLabels = {
	get idle() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.read');
	},
	get responding() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.responding');
	},
	get completed() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.completed');
	},
	get stopped() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.stopped');
	},
	get error() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.incomplete');
	}
};
const toolLabels = {
	get pending() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.toolPending');
	},
	get running() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.toolRunning');
	},
	get completed() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.toolCompleted');
	},
	get error() {
		return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.toolError');
	}
};
const key = (state: ChatSnapshot) =>
	JSON.stringify([state.generation, state.selected === null ? null : chatKey(state.selected)]);
function scroll() {
	const el = viewport.value;
	if (!el || restoring) return;
	near = el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight - el.scrollTop < 64;
	positions.set(key(props.state), el.scrollTop);
	if (near) unread.value = false;
}
function latest() {
	const el = viewport.value;
	if (el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
	near = true;
	unread.value = false;
}
watch(
	() => [key(props.state), props.state.messages] as const,
	async ([next, messages], [old]) => {
		const token = ++serial;
		const changed = next !== old;
		const shouldFollow = changed ? !positions.has(next) : near;
		restoring = true;
		await nextTick();
		if (!alive || token !== serial) return;
		const el = viewport.value;
		if (el) {
			if (changed && positions.has(next)) el.scrollTop = positions.get(next)!;
			else if (shouldFollow) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
			else if (messages.length) unread.value = true;
			near = el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight - el.scrollTop < 64;
			if (changed || near) unread.value = false;
		}
		restoring = false;
	},
	{ flush: 'post' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	alive = false;
	++serial;
	positions.clear();
});
</script>

import type { ChatId, ChatMessage, ChatSession, ChatTool } from './Types.js';

export function chatKey(id: ChatId): string {
	if (typeof id === 'number' && Number.isFinite(id)) return `number:${id}`;
	if (typeof id === 'string' && id.trim()) return `string:${id}`;
	throw new TypeError('Invalid chat identity');
}
export function isTool(value: unknown): value is ChatTool {
	if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return false;
	const tool = value as Record<string, unknown>;
	return (
		typeof tool.id === 'string' &&
		!!tool.id &&
		typeof tool.name === 'string' &&
		typeof tool.text === 'string' &&
		typeof tool.state === 'string' &&
		['pending', 'running', 'completed', 'error'].includes(tool.state)
	);
}
export function decodeSessions(value: unknown): readonly ChatSession[] {
	if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new TypeError('Invalid sessions');
	const keys = new Set<string>();
	return Object.freeze(
		value.map((row: unknown) => {
			if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') throw new TypeError('Invalid session');
			const item = row as ChatSession;
			const key = chatKey(item.id);
			if (
				keys.has(key) ||
				typeof item.title !== 'string' ||
				!item.title.trim() ||
				(item.canSend !== undefined && typeof item.canSend !== 'boolean')
			)
				throw new TypeError('Invalid session');
			keys.add(key);
			return Object.freeze({ id: item.id, title: item.title, canSend: item.canSend });
		})
	);
}
export function decodeMessages(value: unknown): readonly ChatMessage[] {
	if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new TypeError('Invalid history');
	const ids = new Set<string>();
	return Object.freeze(
		value.map((row: unknown) => {
			if (!row || typeof row !== 'object') throw new TypeError('Invalid message');
			const message = row as ChatMessage;
			if (
				typeof message.id !== 'string' ||
				!message.id ||
				ids.has(message.id) ||
				!['user', 'assistant', 'tool'].includes(message.role) ||
				typeof message.text !== 'string' ||
				((message.role === 'tool' || message.tool !== undefined) &&
					!isTool(message.tool)) ||
				(message.phase !== undefined &&
					!['idle', 'responding', 'completed', 'stopped', 'error'].includes(
						message.phase
					))
			)
				throw new TypeError('Invalid message');
			ids.add(message.id);
			// Read persisted content, never trust a persisted live attempt or reply identity.
			return Object.freeze({
				id: message.id,
				role: message.role,
				text: message.text,
				tool: message.tool ? Object.freeze({ ...message.tool }) : undefined,
				phase: message.phase === 'responding' ? 'stopped' : message.phase
			});
		})
	);
}

import {
	createLatestRequest,
	createRequestClient,
	createTransportProvider,
	TransportFault
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type { RequestClient, RequestLog, SafeError } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { chatDemoConfig } from './Config.js';
import { chatKey, decodeMessages, decodeSessions } from './Protocol.js';
import type { ChatId, ChatMessage, ChatReadContext, ChatService, ChatSession } from './Types.js';

export type ChatScenario =
	'normal' | 'empty' | 'read-error' | 'auth' | 'partial-error' | 'eof' | 'once';
function wait(ms: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		const abort = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(new TransportFault('cancelled'));
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			resolve();
		}, ms);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		if (signal.aborted) {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
			abort();
		}
	});
}
function unwrap(body: unknown): unknown {
	if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || !('data' in body))
		throw new TransportFault('business');
	return body.data;
}

/** One latest owner per invocation, so borrowing the same service never cancels another view. */
export function createChatReader(client: RequestClient): Pick<ChatService, 'list' | 'history'> {
	async function load<T>(
		url: string,
		context: ChatReadContext,
		decode: (value: unknown) => T,
		id?: ChatId
	) {
		const latest = createLatestRequest<T>(client, () => {});
		try {
			return await latest.load(
				{ url, params: { scope: context.scope, id } },
				{ signal: context.signal, unwrap, decode }
			);
		} finally {
			latest.dispose();
		}
	}
	return {
		list: (context) => load('/local/chat/sessions', context, decodeSessions),
		history: (id, context) => load('/local/chat/history', context, decodeMessages, id)
	};
}
export function createChatDemo(i18n?: AsamI18n) {
	let scenario: ChatScenario = 'normal';
	let authRevision = 1;
	let pendingReads = 0,
		pendingResponses = 0,
		readCalls = 0,
		responseCalls = 0,
		unwrapCalls = 0;
	const feedback: SafeError[] = [],
		logs: RequestLog[] = [];
	const sessions: readonly ChatSession[] = Object.freeze(
		Array.from({ length: chatDemoConfig.sessionCount }, (_, index) => ({
			id: index === 0 ? 0 : index === 1 ? '0' : `session-${index}`,
			title:
				index === 0
					? '季度复盘与行动整理'
					: index === 1
						? '资料核对与提问清单'
						: `工作记录 ${index + 1}`,
			canSend: index !== 19
		}))
	);
	function history(id: ChatId): readonly ChatMessage[] {
		return Array.from({ length: chatDemoConfig.historyCount }, (_, index) => {
			const tool = index % 15 === 14;
			return {
				id: `history:${chatKey(id)}:${index}`,
				role: tool ? 'tool' : index % 2 === 0 ? 'user' : 'assistant',
				text: tool
					? '本地资料已归类，此处仅展示只读工具状态。'
					: index % 11 === 0
						? '本周项目资料已整理，请核对阶段目标和交付日期。\n相关记录保留原文，便于团队继续讨论。\n```ts\nconst message = "<script>不会执行</script>";\n```\nProjectAtlasQuarterlyResearchArchive2026'.repeat(
								3
							)
						: index % 2 === 0
							? `请整理第 ${index + 1} 条工作记录。`
							: `已保留第 ${index + 1} 条记录的上下文。下一步请核对负责人和日期。`,
				...(tool
					? {
							tool: {
								id: `history-tool-${index}`,
								name: '本地记录',
								state: 'completed' as const,
								text: '归类完成'
							}
						}
					: {})
			};
		});
	}
	const client = createRequestClient({
		i18n,
		auth: () => ({ Authorization: `Bearer synthetic-local-${authRevision}` }),
		transport: async (input, context) => {
			++readCalls;
			++pendingReads;
			const selected = scenario;
			try {
				await wait(chatDemoConfig.readDelayMs, context.signal);
				if (selected === 'auth') return { mode: 'raw', status: 401, body: null };
				if (selected === 'read-error') throw new TransportFault('network');
				if (!context.headers.Authorization?.startsWith('Bearer synthetic-local-'))
					throw new TransportFault('auth');
				const data =
					selected === 'empty'
						? []
						: input.url.endsWith('/sessions')
							? sessions
							: history(input.params?.id as ChatId);
				return { mode: 'raw', status: 200, body: { data } };
			} finally {
				--pendingReads;
			}
		},
		present: (error) => {
			feedback.push(error);
		},
		log: (event) => {
			logs.push(event);
		}
	});
	const countedUnwrap = (body: unknown) => {
		++unwrapCalls;
		return unwrap(body);
	};
	const provider = createTransportProvider(client, countedUnwrap);
	const reader = createChatReader(client);
	const service: ChatService = {
		...reader,
		async respond(request, context) {
			++responseCalls;
			++pendingResponses;
			const selected = scenario;
			let sequence = 0;
			try {
				if (selected === 'once') {
					await wait(
						chatDemoConfig.deltaDelayMs * chatDemoConfig.fragments.length,
						context.signal
					);
					return { mode: 'complete', text: chatDemoConfig.fragments.join('') };
				}
				context.emit({ type: 'start', attemptId: request.attemptId, sequence: ++sequence });
				for (let index = 0; index < chatDemoConfig.fragments.length; index++) {
					await wait(chatDemoConfig.deltaDelayMs, context.signal);
					context.emit({
						type: 'text-delta',
						attemptId: request.attemptId,
						sequence: ++sequence,
						text: chatDemoConfig.fragments[index]!
					});
					if (index === 3)
						context.emit({
							type: 'tool-state',
							attemptId: request.attemptId,
							sequence: ++sequence,
							tool: {
								id: 'organize',
								name: '本地记录整理',
								state: 'running',
								text: '正在整理合成资料，仅展示状态。'
							}
						});
					if (index === 5 && selected === 'partial-error') {
						context.emit({
							type: 'error',
							attemptId: request.attemptId,
							sequence: ++sequence,
							code: 'unavailable'
						});
						return { mode: 'events' };
					}
				}
				context.emit({
					type: 'tool-state',
					attemptId: request.attemptId,
					sequence: ++sequence,
					tool: {
						id: 'organize',
						name: '本地记录整理',
						state: 'completed',
						text: chatDemoConfig.toolText
					}
				});
				if (selected !== 'eof')
					context.emit({
						type: 'complete',
						attemptId: request.attemptId,
						sequence: ++sequence
					});
				return { mode: 'events' };
			} finally {
				--pendingResponses;
			}
		}
	};
	return {
		service,
		provider,
		setScenario(value: ChatScenario) {
			scenario = value;
		},
		rotateAuth() {
			++authRevision;
		},
		/** Demonstrates provider's single unwrap and its existing present de-duplication. */
		async probeProvider() {
			try {
				return await provider.request!(
					{ url: '/local/chat/sessions' },
					{ signal: new AbortController().signal, requestId: 1, scope: 'demo', epoch: 1 }
				);
			} catch (cause) {
				provider.onError?.({
					kind: 'request',
					message: '本地读取失败',
					cause,
					notified: client.isErrorNotified(cause)
				});
				return undefined;
			}
		},
		diagnostics: () => ({
			pendingReads,
			pendingResponses,
			readCalls,
			responseCalls,
			unwrapCalls,
			feedback: [...feedback],
			logs: [...logs]
		}),
		/** Only the application that created this demo owns this disposer. Pages never call it. */
		dispose: () => client.dispose()
	};
}

import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import { useChatI18n } from './I18n.js';
const i18n = useChatI18n();
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

.chat-page {

}
.chat-brand .chat-thread {

}
.chat-brand .thread-heading {

}
.chat-tech {

.chat-tech-header {

}

.chat-tech .chat-sessions,

import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { VNode } from 'vue';

export type ChatId = string | number;
export type ChatPhase = 'idle' | 'responding' | 'completed' | 'stopped' | 'error';
export type ChatReadPhase = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';
export interface ChatSession {
	readonly id: ChatId;
	readonly title: string;
	/** UI affordance only. The host must enforce real authorization. */
	readonly canSend?: boolean;
}
export interface ChatTool {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly name: string;
	readonly state: 'pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'error';
	readonly text: string;
}
export interface ChatMessage {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'tool';
	readonly text: string;
	readonly tool?: ChatTool;
	readonly attemptId?: string;
	readonly replyTo?: string;
	readonly phase?: ChatPhase;
}
export interface ChatReadContext {
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly generation: number;
	readonly signal: AbortSignal;
}
export interface ChatRequest {
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly generation: number;
	readonly sessionId: ChatId;
	readonly userId: string;
	readonly attemptId: string;
	readonly text: string;
}
interface EventIdentity {
	readonly attemptId: string;
	/** Contiguous positive integers starting at one, including start and terminal. */
	readonly sequence: number;
}
export type ChatEvent = EventIdentity &
	(
		| { readonly type: 'start' }
		| { readonly type: 'text-delta'; readonly text: string }
		| { readonly type: 'tool-state'; readonly tool: ChatTool }
		| { readonly type: 'complete' }
		| { readonly type: 'error'; readonly code: 'unavailable' | 'denied' }
	);
export type ChatResponse =
	| { readonly mode: 'events' }
	| { readonly mode: 'complete'; readonly text: string; readonly tools?: readonly ChatTool[] };
export interface ChatService {
	list(context: ChatReadContext): Promise<readonly ChatSession[]>;
	history(id: ChatId, context: ChatReadContext): Promise<readonly ChatMessage[]>;
	/** Wire/SSE/JSON/provider authentication belongs to the host. No automatic retries. */
	respond(
		request: ChatRequest,
		context: { readonly signal: AbortSignal; readonly emit: (event: ChatEvent) => void }
	): ChatResponse | Promise<ChatResponse>;
}
export interface ChatOptions {
	readonly service: ChatService;
	readonly scope?: string;
	readonly readonly?: boolean;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
	/** Covers the entire response, including a host that never settles. Default 15000. */
	readonly responseTimeoutMs?: number;
}
export interface ChatSnapshot {
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly generation: number;
	readonly sessions: readonly ChatSession[];
	readonly selected: ChatId | null;
	readonly messages: readonly ChatMessage[];
	readonly draft: string;
	readonly listPhase: ChatReadPhase;
	readonly historyPhase: ChatReadPhase;
	readonly listError: string;
	readonly historyError: string;
	readonly responseError: string;
	readonly phase: ChatPhase;
	readonly readonly: boolean;
	readonly disabled: boolean;
	readonly canSend: boolean;
	readonly canRetry: boolean;
	readonly discardedEvents: number;
}
export interface ChatPageProps extends ChatOptions {
	readonly title?: string;
	readonly size?: AsamControlSize;
	/** A local host callback. No URL/returnTo is accepted by the template. */
	readonly back?: () => void | Promise<void>;
}
export interface ChatPageExpose {
	focusComposer(): void;
	stop(): void;
	reset(): void;
}
export interface ChatPageEmits {
	status: [phase: ChatPhase];
}
export interface ChatPageSlots {
	header?: () => VNode[];
}

import { ref, readonly } from 'vue';
import type { ChatController } from '../Controller.js';
import { chatKey } from '../Protocol.js';
import type { ChatbotPageProps } from './Types.js';

/** Owns only the optional local creation callback; chat state stays in the original controller. */
export function createChatbotSessionAction(
	controller: ChatController,
	getHost: () => Readonly<ChatbotPageProps>
) {
	const pending = ref(false);
	const error = ref<'createFailed' | 'createTimeout' | ''>('');
	let alive = true;
	let cancelling = false;
	let active: { abort: AbortController; readDomain?: () => boolean } | undefined;
	function cancel() {
		if (cancelling) return;
		cancelling = true;
		const old = active;
		active = undefined;
		error.value = '';
		try {
			old?.abort.abort();
			if (old?.readDomain?.()) controller.cancelReads();
		} finally {
			cancelling = false;
			pending.value = false;
		}
	}
	async function start(): Promise<boolean> {
		const host = getHost();
		if (
			!alive ||
			cancelling ||
			pending.value ||
			!host.createSession ||
			host.readonly ||
			host.disabled
		)
			return false;
		const timeout = host.sessionCreateTimeoutMs ?? 10000;
		if (!Number.isFinite(timeout) || timeout < 1 || timeout > 2147483647)
			throw new TypeError('Invalid sessionCreateTimeoutMs');
		const create = host.createSession;
		const service = host.service;
		const scope = host.scope ?? '';
		const generation = controller.state.value.generation;
		const operation: { abort: AbortController; readDomain?: () => boolean } = {
			abort: new AbortController()
		};
		active = operation;
		pending.value = true;
		error.value = '';
		controller.stop();
		controller.cancelReads();
		const sameHost = () => {
			const current = getHost();
			return (
				alive &&
				active === operation &&
				current.service === service &&
				current.createSession === create &&
				(current.scope ?? '') === scope &&
				controller.state.value.generation === generation &&
				!current.readonly &&
				!current.disabled
			);
		};
		const isCurrent = () => sameHost() && !operation.abort.signal.aborted;
		let timedOut = false;
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			if (active !== operation) return;
			timedOut = true;
			try {
				if (operation.readDomain?.()) controller.cancelReads();
			} finally {
				operation.abort.abort();
			}
		}, timeout);
		let rejectAbort: (() => void) | undefined;
		try {
			const cancelled = new Promise<never>((_resolve, reject) => {
				rejectAbort = () => reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
				operation.abort.signal.addEventListener('abort', rejectAbort, { once: true });
			});
			if (!isCurrent()) return false;
			const id = await Promise.race([
				create({ scope, generation, signal: operation.abort.signal, isCurrent }),
				cancelled
			]);
			if (!isCurrent()) return false;
			chatKey(id);
			operation.readDomain = () =>
				controller.state.value.generation === generation &&
				controller.state.value.scope === scope;
			if (!(await Promise.race([controller.reload(), cancelled])) || !isCurrent()) {
				if (sameHost()) error.value = 'createFailed';
				return false;
			}
			if (!controller.state.value.sessions.some((row) => chatKey(row.id) === chatKey(id))) {
				error.value = 'createFailed';
				return false;
			}
			return (await Promise.race([controller.select(id), cancelled])) && isCurrent();
		} catch {
			if (sameHost()) error.value = timedOut ? 'createTimeout' : 'createFailed';
			return false;
		} finally {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			if (rejectAbort) operation.abort.signal.removeEventListener('abort', rejectAbort);
			if (active === operation) {
				active = undefined;
				pending.value = false;
			}
		}
	}
	return {
		pending: readonly(pending),
		error: readonly(error),
		start,
		cancel,
		dispose() {
			alive = false;
			cancel();
		}
	};
}

<template>
	<component
		:is="inheritAppearance ? 'div' : AsamApplicationProvider"
		class="chatbot-demo-host"
		:config="{ size, colorMode: dark ? 'dark' : 'light', base: { i18n } }"
		><div class="chatbot-demo">
			<Teleport to="#preview-settings-extra" :disabled="!websitePreviewControls"
				><WebsiteAsamConfigProvider size="default"
					><section class="preview-control-group">

							<summary>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.exampleSettings') }}</summary>
							<p>{{ t('localHint') }}</p>
							<div class="chatbot-demo-tools">
								<label v-if="!externalI18n"
									>{{ t('language') }}
									<AsamSelect
										:size="size"
										:model-value="i18n.locale.value"
										@update:model-value="setLocale"
										><AsamOption value="zh-CN" label="简体中文" /><AsamOption
											value="en"
											label="English" /></AsamSelect
								></label>
								<div class="preview-choice-field">
									<span>{{ t('createMode') }} </span
									><WebsiteAsamRadioGroup
										:size="size"
										:model-value="fixture.controls.createMode"
										@update:model-value="setCreateMode"
										class="preview-choice-grid"
										:ariaLabel="String(t('createMode')) + ' '"
										><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="normal" border>{{
											t('createNormal')
										}}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem
										><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="error" border>{{
											t('createError')
										}}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem
										><WebsiteAsamRadioItem value="timeout" border>{{
											t('createNever')
										}}</WebsiteAsamRadioItem></WebsiteAsamRadioGroup
									>
								</div>
								<label
									>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.exampleSize') }}
									<AsamSelect
										:size="size"
										:model-value="size"
										@update:model-value="setSize"
										><AsamOption
											v-for="value in sizes"
											:key="value"
											:value="value"
											:label="value" /></AsamSelect></label
								><span
									v-show="!websitePreviewControls"
									data-preview-theme-control
									:data-preview-value="dark"
									v-on="{ 'asam-preview-theme': websitePreviewTheme0 }"
									><AsamCheckboxItem
										v-if="!inheritAppearance"
										:size="size"
										:model-value="dark"
										@update:model-value="setDark"
										border
										>{{
											i18n.t('app.templates.chat.exampleDark')
										}}</AsamCheckboxItem
									></span
								><AsamCheckboxItem
									:size="size"
									:model-value="fixture.controls.readonly"
									@update:model-value="setPolicy('readonly', $event)"
									border
									>{{
										i18n.t('app.templates.chat.exampleReadonly')
									}}</AsamCheckboxItem
								><AsamCheckboxItem
									:size="size"
									:model-value="fixture.controls.disabled"
									@update:model-value="setPolicy('disabled', $event)"
									border
									>{{
										i18n.t('app.templates.chat.exampleDisabled')
									}}</AsamCheckboxItem
								>
								<div class="preview-choice-field">

										"
										><WebsiteAsamRadioItem

								<AsamButton
									type="default"

										fixture.controls.identity =
											fixture.controls.identity === 'reader-a'

									"
									>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.exampleScope') }}</AsamButton
								><AsamButton
									type="default"

									@click="fixture.controls.serviceRevision++"
									>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.exampleService') }}</AsamButton
								><AsamButton type="default" :size="size" @click="toggleMounted">{{

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');
function websitePreviewTheme0(event: CustomEvent<'light' | 'dark'>) {
	setDark(event.detail === 'dark');
}
function websiteNativeEvent(value: unknown, type: string) {
	const event = new Event(type);
	Object.defineProperty(event, 'target', { value: { value, checked: value } });
	return event;
}

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamCard, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamOption, AsamSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { ChatScenario } from '../Service.js';
import ChatbotPage from './ChatbotPage.vue';
import { createChatbotFixture } from './Fixture.js';
import { useChatbotText } from './I18n.js';
defineProps<{ externalI18n?: AsamI18n; inheritAppearance?: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ locale: [value: 'zh-CN' | 'en'] }>();
const { i18n, t } = useChatbotText();
const fixture = createChatbotFixture(i18n);
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
const dark = ref(false);
const mounted = ref(true);
const destination = ref<'chat' | 'home'>('chat');
const host = computed(() => ({
	...fixture.host.value,
	back: async () => {
		destination.value = 'home';
	}
}));
const sizes: readonly AsamControlSize[] = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'];
const scenarios = [
	{ value: 'normal', key: 'app.templates.chat.exampleNormal' },
	{ value: 'empty', key: 'app.templates.chat.exampleEmpty' },
	{ value: 'read-error', key: 'app.templates.chat.exampleReadError' },
	{ value: 'auth', key: 'app.templates.chat.exampleAuthError' },
	{ value: 'partial-error', key: 'app.templates.chat.examplePartialError' },
	{ value: 'eof', key: 'app.templates.chat.exampleEof' },
	{ value: 'once', key: 'app.templates.chat.exampleOnce' }
] as const;
function toggleMounted() {
	mounted.value = !mounted.value;
}
function setDark(value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'boolean') dark.value = value;
}
function setPolicy(key: 'readonly' | 'disabled', value: unknown) {
	if (typeof value === 'boolean') fixture.controls[key] = value;
}
function setSize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'small' || value === 'default' || value === 'big' || value === 'large')
		size.value = value;
}
function setLocale(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'zh-CN' || value === 'en') emit('locale', value);
}
function setScenario(value: unknown) {
	const found = scenarios.find((item) => item.value === value);
	if (found) fixture.setScenario(found.value satisfies ChatScenario);
}
function setCreateMode(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'normal' || value === 'error' || value === 'timeout')
		fixture.controls.createMode = value;
}
onBeforeUnmount(fixture.dispose);
defineExpose({ diagnostics: fixture.diagnostics });
</script>

vue
<!-- 模板排版遵循仓库Prettier，以下仅关闭与其冲突的格式规则。 -->
<!-- eslint-disable vue/html-indent, vue/html-closing-bracket-newline, vue/html-self-closing, vue/multiline-html-element-content-newline, vue/max-attributes-per-line -->
<template>
	<AsamConfigProvider :i18n="i18n" :size="size"
		><section
			ref="origin"
			class="chat-page chatbot-page"
			:class="{ 'chatbot-page-compact': compact }"
			:data-size="size"
			data-chatbot-page
		>
			<component
				:is="compact ? AsamDrawer : 'aside'"
				v-bind="
					compact
						? {
								modelValue: navigationOpen,
								direction: 'ltr',
								appendToBody: true,
								size: 'min(360px, 100vw)',
								title: i18n.t('app.templates.chat.sessionsTitle'),
								style: layerStyle
							}
						: { class: 'chatbot-sidebar' }
				"
				@update:model-value="navigationOpen = $event"
				@closed="finishNavigation"
				><div
					class="chatbot-navigation"
					:class="{ 'chat-page chatbot-navigation-compact': compact }"
				>
					<div class="chatbot-session-tools">
						<AsamButton
							type="primary"
							:size="size"
							:disabled="
								!props.createSession || state.readonly || state.disabled || creating
							"
							@click="newConversation"
							>{{ t('newConversation') }}</AsamButton
						><AsamButton
							type="default"
							:size="size"
							:disabled="state.disabled || creating"
							@click="showManagement"
							>{{ t('manage') }}</AsamButton
						>
					</div>
					<p v-if="!props.createSession" class="chatbot-muted">
						{{ t('createUnavailable') }}
					</p>
					<SessionList
						:state="interactionState"
						:controller="controller"
						:size="size"
						@select="selectSession"
					/></div
			></component>
			<div class="chatbot-main">
				<header class="chatbot-header">
					<div class="chatbot-heading">
						<p class="chatbot-muted">{{ props.title ?? t('title') }}</p>
						<h1>{{ title }}</h1>
					</div>
					<div class="chatbot-header-actions">
						<AsamTag v-if="props.synthetic" type="info" effect="plain">{{
							t('synthetic')
						}}</AsamTag
						><AsamButton
							v-if="compact"
							type="default"
							:size="size"
							v-bind="navigationTriggerAttrs"
							@click="navigationOpen = true"
							>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.sessionsTitle') }}</AsamButton
						><AsamButton
							v-if="props.back"
							type="default"
							:size="size"
							:disabled="backPending || creating"
							@click="back"
							>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.chat.back') }}</AsamButton
						>
					</div>
				</header>
				<p v-if="backError" class="chatbot-operation" role="alert">{{ backError }}</p>
				<div v-if="creating" class="chatbot-operation" role="status">
					{{ t('creating') }}
					<AsamButton type="default" :size="size" @click="actions.cancel()">{{
						t('cancelCreate')
					}}</AsamButton>
				</div>
				<p v-if="createError" class="chatbot-operation" role="alert">
					{{ t(createError) }}
				</p>
				<p v-if="relatedError" class="chatbot-operation" role="alert">
					{{ t('relatedUnavailable') }}
				</p>
				<MessageHistory :state="interactionState" :controller="controller" :size="size"
					><template #empty="{ selected }"
						><AsamEmpty :description="selected ? t('welcome') : t('selectOrCreate')"
							><div class="chatbot-suggestions">
								<AsamButton
									v-for="suggestion in suggestions"
									:key="suggestion"
									type="primary"
									plain
									:size="size"
									:disabled="!selected || !state.canSend || creating"
									@click="suggest(suggestion)"
									>{{ suggestion }}</AsamButton
								>
							</div></AsamEmpty
						></template
					><template #message="{ message }"
						><MessageContent
							:key="messageKey(message)"
							:message="message"
							:presentation="presentationFor(message)"
							:size="size"
							:disabled="state.disabled || creating || !props.relatedProject"
							@related="openRelated" /></template></MessageHistory
				><Composer
					ref="composer"
					class="chatbot-composer"
					:state="interactionState"
					:controller="controller"
					:size="size"
					><template #actions
						><AsamButton
							type="default"
							:size="size"
							:disabled="!state.draft || draftLocked || creating"
							@click="clearDraft"
							>{{ t('clearDraft') }}</AsamButton
						></template
					></Composer
				>
			</div>
			<AsamDialog
				v-model="manage"
				append-to-body
				class="chatbot-management-dialog"
				:style="layerStyle"
				:title="t('manage')"
				width="min(640px, calc(100vw - 32px))"
				><AsamTable :data="sessionRows"
					><!-- @vue-generic {ChatSession} --><AsamTableColumn
						prop="title"
						:label="t('sessionTitle')"
						min-width="180"
					/><!-- @vue-generic {ChatSession} --><AsamTableColumn
						:label="t('openConversation')"
						min-width="150"
						><template #default="{ row }"
							><AsamButton
								:size="size"
								type="default"
								:disabled="state.disabled || creating"
								@click="selectManaged(row.id)"
								>{{ t('openConversation') }}</AsamButton
							></template
						></AsamTableColumn
					></AsamTable
				><template #footer
					><AsamButton type="default" :size="size" @click="manage = false">{{
						t('close')
					}}</AsamButton></template
				></AsamDialog
			><AsamDrawer
				append-to-body
				class="chatbot-related-drawer"
				:style="layerStyle"
				:model-value="!!project"
				:title="project?.title ?? t('relatedTitle')"
				size="min(480px, 100vw)"
				@update:model-value="closeRelated"
				><template v-if="project"
					><AsamDescriptions :column="1" direction="vertical"
						><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="t('projectStatus')">{{
							project.status
						}}</AsamDescriptionsItem
						><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="t('projectDescription')">{{
							project.description
						}}</AsamDescriptionsItem></AsamDescriptions
					>
					<h2>{{ t('projectItems') }}</h2>
					<ul>
						<li v-for="(item, index) in project.items" :key="index">{{ item }}</li>
					</ul></template
				><template #footer
					><AsamButton type="default" :size="size" @click="project = undefined">{{
						t('backToChat')
					}}</AsamButton></template
				></AsamDrawer
			>
		</section></AsamConfigProvider
	>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import type {} from './Models.js';
import { computed, nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamConfigProvider,
	AsamDescriptions,
	AsamDescriptionsItem,
	AsamDialog,
	AsamDrawer,
	AsamEmpty,
	AsamTable,
	AsamTableColumn,
	AsamTag
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { ChatId, ChatMessage, ChatPageEmits, ChatPageExpose, ChatSession } from '../Types.js';
import { useChatPage } from '../useChatPage.js';
import { chatKey } from '../Protocol.js';
import SessionList from '../SessionList.vue';
import MessageHistory from '../MessageHistory.vue';
import Composer from '../Composer.vue';
import MessageContent from './MessageContent.vue';
import { createChatbotSessionAction } from './Actions.js';
import { useChatbotText } from './I18n.js';
import { useScopedDialogStyle } from './DialogStyle.js';
import type { ChatbotPageProps, ChatbotRelatedProject, ChatbotReadContext } from './Types.js';
import '../Style.css';
const props = defineProps<ChatbotPageProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<ChatPageEmits>();
const {
	controller,
	state,
	size,
	composer,
	title,
	back,
	backPending,
	backError,
	focusComposer,
	stop
} = useChatPage(props, (phase) => emit('status', phase));
const { i18n, t } = useChatbotText();
const actions = createChatbotSessionAction(controller, () => props);
const creating = actions.pending;
const createError = actions.error;
const manage = ref(false);
const compact = shallowRef(false);
const navigationOpen = ref(false);
const navigationTriggerAttrs = computed<Pick<HTMLAttributes, 'aria-haspopup' | 'aria-expanded'>>(
	() => ({
		'aria-haspopup': 'dialog',
		'aria-expanded': navigationOpen.value
	})
);
let afterNavigation: 'manage' | 'compose' | undefined;
let navigationObserver: ResizeObserver | undefined;
const project = shallowRef<ChatbotRelatedProject>();
const relatedError = ref(false);
const origin = ref<HTMLElement>();
const layerStyle = useScopedDialogStyle(
	origin,
	() => navigationOpen.value || manage.value || !!project.value
);
const interactionState = computed(() =>
	creating.value
		? { ...state.value, disabled: true, canSend: false, canRetry: false }
		: state.value
);
const sessionRows = computed<ChatSession[]>(() => [...state.value.sessions]);
const draftLocked = computed(
	() =>
		state.value.readonly ||
		state.value.disabled ||
		state.value.sessions.find((row) => row.id === state.value.selected)?.canSend === false
);
const suggestions = computed(() => [
	t('suggestionTasks'),
	t('suggestionReport'),
	t('suggestionComponents')
]);
const messageKey = (message: ChatMessage) =>
	JSON.stringify([
		state.value.generation,
		state.value.selected === null ? null : chatKey(state.value.selected),
		message.id
	]);
function context(): ChatbotReadContext | undefined {
	const snapshot = state.value;
	return snapshot.selected === null
		? undefined
		: {
				scope: snapshot.scope,
				generation: snapshot.generation,
				sessionId: snapshot.selected
			};
}
function presentationFor(message: ChatMessage) {
	const current = context();
	if (!current || message.role !== 'assistant') return undefined;
	try {
		const value = props.presentation?.(message, current);
		if (
			!value ||
			(value.summary !== undefined && typeof value.summary !== 'string') ||
			(value.markdown !== undefined && typeof value.markdown !== 'boolean') ||
			(value.related !== undefined &&
				(!Array.isArray(value.related) ||
					value.related.some((id) => typeof id !== 'string' || !id.trim()) ||
					new Set(value.related).size !== value.related.length))
		)
			return undefined;
		return value;
	} catch {
		return undefined;
	}
}
async function newConversation() {
	if (await actions.start()) {
		if (navigationOpen.value) {
			afterNavigation = 'compose';
			navigationOpen.value = false;
			return;
		}
		await nextTick();
		focusComposer();
	}
}
function showManagement() {
	if (navigationOpen.value) {
		afterNavigation = 'manage';
		navigationOpen.value = false;
	} else manage.value = true;
}
function finishNavigation() {
	const action = afterNavigation;
	afterNavigation = undefined;
	if (action === 'manage') manage.value = true;
	if (action === 'compose') focusComposer();
}
function syncNavigation(width: number) {
	compact.value = width < 840;
	if (compact.value) return;
	navigationOpen.value = false;
	afterNavigation = undefined;
}
onMounted(() => {
	const element = origin.value;
	if (!element) return;
	syncNavigation(element.clientWidth);
	navigationObserver = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => syncNavigation(entry.contentRect.width));
	navigationObserver.observe(element);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => navigationObserver?.disconnect());
function suggest(text: string) {
	if (!state.value.canSend || creating.value) return;
	controller.setDraft(text);
	focusComposer();
}
function clearDraft() {
	if (creating.value || draftLocked.value) return;
	controller.setDraft('');
	focusComposer();
}
function selectSession(id: ChatId) {
	navigationOpen.value = false;
	void controller.select(id);
}
async function selectManaged(id: ChatId) {
	if (creating.value || state.value.disabled) return;
	manage.value = false;
	if (await controller.select(id)) focusComposer();
}
function openRelated(id: string) {
	const current = context();
	const service = props.service;
	const read = props.relatedProject;
	if (!current || state.value.disabled || creating.value || !read) return;
	const isCurrent = () => {
		const next = context();
		return (
			!!next &&
			!state.value.disabled &&
			service === props.service &&
			read === props.relatedProject &&
			next.scope === current.scope &&
			next.generation === current.generation &&
			chatKey(next.sessionId) === chatKey(current.sessionId)
		);
	};
	try {
		const value = read(id, current);
		if (!isCurrent()) return;
		if (
			!value ||
			value.id !== id ||
			[value.title, value.status, value.description].some(
				(item) => typeof item !== 'string'
			) ||
			!Array.isArray(value.items) ||
			value.items.some((item) => typeof item !== 'string')
		) {
			relatedError.value = true;
			return;
		}
		relatedError.value = false;
		project.value = Object.freeze({ ...value, items: Object.freeze([...value.items]) });
	} catch {
		if (isCurrent()) relatedError.value = true;
	}
}
function closeRelated(open: boolean) {
	if (!open) project.value = undefined;
}
watch(
	[
		() => state.value.generation,
		() => props.service,
		() => props.scope,
		() => props.createSession,
		() => props.readonly,
		() => props.disabled
	],
	() => {
		actions.cancel();
		navigationOpen.value = false;
		afterNavigation = undefined;
		manage.value = false;
		project.value = undefined;
		relatedError.value = false;
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	() => state.value.selected,
	() => {
		project.value = undefined;
		relatedError.value = false;
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
watch(
	[() => props.relatedProject, () => props.presentation],
	() => {
		project.value = undefined;
		relatedError.value = false;
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(actions.dispose);
defineExpose<ChatPageExpose>({
	focusComposer,
	stop,
	reset: () => {
		actions.cancel();
		manage.value = false;
		project.value = undefined;
		controller.reset();
	}
});
</script>

.chatbot-navigation :deep(.chat-sessions .asam-button[data-session] > span) {

import { renderAsamMarkdown } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { ChatMessage } from '../Types.js';
import type { ChatbotPresentation } from './Types.js';

/** Only the new page's explicit assistant presentation opts into the existing public renderer. */
export function renderChatbotMarkdown(message: ChatMessage, presentation?: ChatbotPresentation) {
	return message.role === 'assistant' && presentation?.markdown && message.text
		? renderAsamMarkdown(message.text)
		: '';
}

import type { ChatbotRelatedProject } from './Types.js';

/** Local synthetic content only. Timing and response event sequencing remain in the old service. */
export function chatbotContent(locale: string) {
	const en = locale === 'en';
	const fragments = en
		? [
				'## This week’s project progress\n\n',
				'1. **The design system is in component integration.** ',
				'Form and data presentation conventions are ready; check responsive scenarios next.\n',
				'2. **The equipment register has consistent records.** ',
				'Categories, owners and maintenance records now use a shared structure.\n',
				'3. **The service handbook has more common questions.** ',
				'Prioritize error handling and traceable source information.\n\n',
				'```ts\n',
				'const next = items.filter(item => item.ready);\n',
				'console.log(next.length);\n',
				'```\n',
				'This is local synthetic content. Check it against your actual records.'
			]
		: [
				'## 本周项目进展\n\n',
				'1. **设计系统进入组件联调。** ',
				'已完成主要表单和数据展示规范，下一步验证响应式场景。\n',
				'2. **设备台账完成数据梳理。** ',
				'资产分类、负责人和维护记录已具备统一结构。\n',
				'3. **服务手册补充常见问题。** ',
				'建议优先完善异常处理与回溯入口。\n\n',
				'```ts\n',
				'const next = items.filter(item => item.ready);\n',
				'console.log(next.length);\n',
				'```\n',
				'内容来自本地合成示例，请结合实际资料核对。'
			];
	const summary = en
		? 'The service supplied this public summary of project status, dates and next actions from local synthetic records.'
		: '服务按本地合成记录中的项目状态、时间和待办信息提供了这段可公开的简短摘要。';
	const project: ChatbotRelatedProject = Object.freeze({
		id: 'project-progress',
		title: en ? 'Equipment register improvement' : '设备台账体验优化',
		status: en ? 'Local synthetic project' : '本地合成项目',
		description: en
			? 'A local example connecting the design system, equipment register and service handbook.'
			: '关联设计系统、设备台账与服务手册的本地示例资料。',
		items: Object.freeze(
			en
				? [
						'Check responsive component integration.',
						'Confirm equipment owners and maintenance records.',
						'Complete error handling references.'
					]
				: [
						'核对组件联调的响应式场景。',
						'确认资产负责人和维护记录。',
						'补充异常处理与回溯资料。'
					]
		)
	});
	return { fragments: Object.freeze(fragments), summary, project };
}

import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import type { Ref } from 'vue';

/** Carry the actual host scope's ASAM/EP variables across a public body teleport.
 * No global theme writes and no duplicate token-generation algorithm. */
export function useScopedDialogStyle(origin: Ref<HTMLElement | undefined>, open: () => boolean) {
	const variables = shallowRef<Record<string, string>>({});
	let observer: MutationObserver | undefined;
	function collect() {
		if (!open() || !origin.value) return;
		const style = getComputedStyle(origin.value);
		variables.value = {
			color: style.color,
			colorScheme: style.colorScheme,
			fontFamily: style.fontFamily,
			...Object.fromEntries(
				Array.from(style)
					.filter((key) => key.startsWith('--asam-') || key.startsWith('--el-'))
					.map((key) => [key, style.getPropertyValue(key)])
			)
		};
	}
	function stop() {
		observer?.disconnect();
		observer = undefined;
		window.removeEventListener('resize', collect);
	}
	watch(
		open,
		(value) => {
			stop();
			if (!value || !origin.value) return;
			collect();
			observer = new MutationObserver(collect);
			for (
				let node: HTMLElement | null = origin.value.parentElement;
				node;
				node = node.parentElement
			)
				observer.observe(node, {
					attributes: true,
					attributeFilter: ['style', 'class', 'data-color-mode']
				});
			window.addEventListener('resize', collect);
		},
		{ flush: 'post' }
	);
	onBeforeUnmount(stop);
	return variables;
}

import { computed, shallowReactive } from 'vue';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createChatDemo } from '../Service.js';
import type { ChatScenario } from '../Service.js';
import type { ChatId, ChatService, ChatSession } from '../Types.js';
import { chatKey } from '../Protocol.js';
import { chatbotContent } from './Data.js';
import type {
	ChatbotCreateContext,
	ChatbotPageProps,
	ChatbotPresentation,
	ChatbotReadContext
} from './Types.js';

/** Adds local page content around the original 20/60/12×100ms service, not another controller. */
export function createChatbotFixture(i18n?: AsamI18n) {
	const base = createChatDemo(i18n);
	const controls = shallowReactive({
		identity: 'reader-a',
		serviceRevision: 0,
		readonly: false,
		disabled: false,
		responseTimeoutMs: 15000,
		scenario: 'normal' as ChatScenario,
		createMode: 'normal' as 'normal' | 'error' | 'timeout'
	});
	const metadata = shallowReactive(new Map<string, ChatbotPresentation>());
	const related = new Set<string>();
	const created = new Map<string, ChatSession[]>();
	const variants = new Map<number, ChatService>();
	const pending = new Set<() => void>();
	let alive = true;
	let sequence = 0;
	let createdCount = 0;
	const locale = () => i18n?.locale.value ?? 'zh-CN';
	const ownScope = () => `chatbot-local:${controls.identity}:${controls.serviceRevision}`;
	const sessionKey = (context: ChatbotReadContext) =>
		JSON.stringify([context.scope, chatKey(context.sessionId)]);
	const messageKey = (context: ChatbotReadContext, id: string, attempt = false) =>
		JSON.stringify([sessionKey(context), attempt ? 'attempt' : 'message', id]);
	const markdownOnly = Object.freeze({ markdown: true });
	function completedPresentation(
		context: ChatbotReadContext,
		id: string,
		attempt: boolean,
		language: string
	) {
		const content = chatbotContent(language);
		metadata.set(
			messageKey(context, id, attempt),
			Object.freeze({
				markdown: true,
				summary: content.summary,
				related: Object.freeze([content.project.id])
			})
		);
		related.add(sessionKey(context));
	}
	function serviceFor(revision: number): ChatService {
		const cached = variants.get(revision);
		if (cached) return cached;
		const service: ChatService = {
			async list(context) {
				const rows = await base.service.list(context);
				if (!alive || context.signal.aborted)
					throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
				const english = locale() === 'en';
				return [
					...(created.get(context.scope) ?? []),
					...rows.map((row, index) => ({
						...row,
						title:
							index === 0
								? english
									? 'Organize project progress'
									: '整理项目进展'
								: index === 1
									? english
										? 'Equipment register fields'
										: '资产台账字段说明'
									: english
										? `Work record ${index + 1}`
										: row.title
					}))
				];
			},
			async history(id, context) {
				if (
					(created.get(context.scope) ?? []).some(
						(row) => chatKey(row.id) === chatKey(id)
					)
				) {
					// Reuse the real read cancellation/error/auth behavior, then return this empty local session.
					await base.service.history(id, context);
					return [];
				}
				const rows = await base.service.history(id, context);
				if (!alive || context.signal.aborted)
					throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
				const language = locale();
				const content = chatbotContent(language);
				const lastAssistant = [...rows].reverse().find((row) => row.role === 'assistant');
				const current = { ...context, sessionId: id };
				return rows.map((row) => {
					if (row.role === 'assistant')
						metadata.set(messageKey(current, row.id), markdownOnly);
					if (row !== lastAssistant) return row;
					completedPresentation(current, row.id, false, language);
					return { ...row, text: content.fragments.join('') };
				});
			},
			async respond(request, context) {
				if (!alive || context.signal.aborted)
					throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
				const language = locale();
				const content = chatbotContent(language);
				const current = {
					scope: request.scope,
					generation: request.generation,
					sessionId: request.sessionId
				};
				metadata.set(messageKey(current, request.attemptId, true), markdownOnly);
				let fragment = 0;
				const result = await base.service.respond(request, {
					signal: context.signal,
					emit(event) {
						if (!alive || context.signal.aborted) return;
						if (event.type === 'complete')
							completedPresentation(current, request.attemptId, true, language);
						context.emit(
							event.type === 'text-delta'
								? { ...event, text: content.fragments[fragment++] ?? event.text }
								: event
						);
					}
				});
				if (result.mode === 'complete' && alive && !context.signal.aborted) {
					completedPresentation(current, request.attemptId, true, language);
					return { ...result, text: content.fragments.join('') };
				}
				return result;
			}
		};
		variants.set(revision, service);
		return service;
	}
	async function createSession(context: ChatbotCreateContext): Promise<ChatId> {
		const current = () =>
			alive &&
			context.isCurrent() &&
			context.scope === ownScope() &&
			!controls.readonly &&
			!controls.disabled &&
			controls.scenario !== 'auth';
		if (!current()) throw Error('Local creation unavailable');
		const mode = controls.createMode;
		await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
			let settled = false;
			const finish = (aborted: boolean) => {
				if (settled) return;
				settled = true;
				clearTimeout(timer);
				pending.delete(cancel);
				context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
				if (aborted) reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
				else resolve();
			};
			const cancel = () => finish(true);
			const timer = mode === 'timeout' ? undefined : setTimeout(() => finish(false), 100);
			pending.add(cancel);
			context.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
			if (context.signal.aborted || !alive) cancel();
		});
		if (!current()) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
		if (mode === 'error') throw Error('Local creation unavailable');
		const id = `chatbot-local-${++sequence}`;
		const row = Object.freeze({
			id,
			title: locale() === 'en' ? `New conversation ${sequence}` : `新对话 ${sequence}`,
			canSend: true
		});
		created.set(context.scope, [row, ...(created.get(context.scope) ?? [])]);
		createdCount++;
		return id;
	}
	const presentation: NonNullable<ChatbotPageProps['presentation']> = (message, context) =>
		metadata.get(messageKey(context, message.attemptId ?? message.id, !!message.attemptId));
	const relatedProject: NonNullable<ChatbotPageProps['relatedProject']> = (id, context) =>
		related.has(sessionKey(context)) && id === 'project-progress'
			? chatbotContent(locale()).project
			: undefined;
	const host = computed<ChatbotPageProps>(() => ({
		service: serviceFor(controls.serviceRevision),
		scope: ownScope(),
		readonly: controls.readonly,
		disabled: controls.disabled,
		responseTimeoutMs: controls.responseTimeoutMs,
		sessionCreateTimeoutMs: 2000,
		synthetic: true,
		createSession,
		presentation,
		relatedProject
	}));
	return {
		controls,
		host,
		setScenario(value: ChatScenario) {
			controls.scenario = value;
			base.setScenario(value);
		},
		diagnostics: () => ({
			...base.diagnostics(),
			createdCount,
			pendingCreations: pending.size
		}),
		dispose() {
			if (!alive) return;
			alive = false;
			for (const cancel of [...pending]) cancel();
			metadata.clear();
			related.clear();
			created.clear();
			variants.clear();
			base.dispose();
		}
	};
}

export function useChatbotText() {
	const i18n = useAsamProI18n(defaults);
	const text = {

import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamAvatar, AsamCollapse, AsamCollapseItem, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { ChatMessage } from '../Types.js';
import type { ChatbotPresentation } from './Types.js';
import { useChatbotText } from './I18n.js';
import { renderChatbotMarkdown } from './Content.js';
const props = defineProps<{
	message: ChatMessage;
	presentation?: ChatbotPresentation;
	size: AsamControlSize;
	disabled: boolean;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ related: [id: string] }>();
const { i18n, t } = useChatbotText();
const roleLabel = computed(() =>
	props.message.role === 'user'
		? i18n.t('app.templates.chat.you')
		: props.message.role === 'tool'
			? props.message.tool?.name
			: i18n.t('app.templates.chat.assistant')
);
const avatar = computed(() =>
	props.message.role === 'assistant' ? 'A' : String(roleLabel.value ?? '').slice(0, 1)
);
const text = computed(
	() =>
		props.message.text ||
		(props.message.phase === 'responding'
			? i18n.t('app.templates.chat.preparing')
			: i18n.t('app.templates.chat.noText'))
);
const phaseLabel = computed(() => {
	switch (props.message.phase) {
		case 'responding':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.responding');
		case 'completed':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.completed');
		case 'stopped':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.stopped');
		case 'error':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.incomplete');
		default:
			return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.read');
	}
});
const toolLabel = computed(() => {
	switch (props.message.tool?.state) {
		case 'pending':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.toolPending');
		case 'running':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.toolRunning');
		case 'completed':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.toolCompleted');
		case 'error':
			return i18n.t('app.templates.chat.toolError');
		default:
			return '';
	}
});
const markdown = computed(() => renderChatbotMarkdown(props.message, props.presentation));
</script>

import type { ChatId, ChatMessage, ChatPageProps, ChatReadContext } from '../Types.js';

/** Page-local presentation supplied by the host, never inferred internal reasoning. */
export interface ChatbotPresentation {
	readonly markdown?: boolean;
	readonly summary?: string;
	readonly related?: readonly string[];
}
export interface ChatbotReadContext {
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly generation: number;
	readonly sessionId: ChatId;
}
export interface ChatbotRelatedProject {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly title: string;
	readonly status: string;
	readonly description: string;
	readonly items: readonly string[];
}
export interface ChatbotCreateContext extends ChatReadContext {
	/** The local host checks this immediately before adding its synthetic session. */
	readonly isCurrent: () => boolean;
}
/** Companion page contract; the original ChatService and streaming protocol are unchanged. */
export interface ChatbotPageProps extends ChatPageProps {
	readonly synthetic?: boolean;
	readonly createSession?: (context: ChatbotCreateContext) => Promise<ChatId>;
	readonly sessionCreateTimeoutMs?: number;
	readonly presentation?: (
		message: ChatMessage,
		context: ChatbotReadContext
	) => ChatbotPresentation | undefined;
	readonly relatedProject?: (
		id: string,
		context: ChatbotReadContext
	) => ChatbotRelatedProject | undefined;
}

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';

export function mountChatbot(
	element: Element,
	host?: { i18n?: AsamI18n; inheritAppearance?: boolean },
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void
) {
	const locale = shallowRef<'zh-CN' | 'en'>('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const app = createApp(App, {
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		onLocale: (value: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'chatbot-local-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	app.mount(element);
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}
ts
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import type { ChatPhase, ChatPageProps } from './Types.js';
import { createChatController } from './Controller.js';
import { useChatI18n } from './I18n.js';
import { createAsamMessageError, formatFieldError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { useAsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';

export function useChatPage(props: Readonly<ChatPageProps>, announce: (phase: ChatPhase) => void) {
	const i18n = useChatI18n();
	const controller = createChatController(props, i18n);
	const state = controller.state;
	const size = useAsamControlSize(() => props.size);
	const composer = ref<{ focus(): void }>();
	const backError = ref<Error>();
	const backPending = ref(false);
	let alive = true;
	watch(
		() => [props.service, props.scope, props.readonly, props.disabled, props.responseTimeoutMs],
		() => controller.configure(props),
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	watch(() => state.value.phase, announce, { flush: 'post' });
	onMounted(() => {
		void controller.reload();
	});
	onBeforeUnmount(() => {
		alive = false;
		controller.dispose();
	});
	async function back() {
		if (!props.back || backPending.value) return;
		backPending.value = true;
		backError.value = undefined;
		try {
			await props.back();
		} catch {
			if (alive)
				backError.value = createAsamMessageError(
					'返回未完成，请重试。',
					'app.templates.chat.backFailed'
				);
		} finally {
			if (alive) backPending.value = false;
		}
	}
	return {
		i18n,
		controller,
		state,
		size,
		composer,
		back,
		backError: computed(() => (backError.value ? formatFieldError(backError.value, i18n) : '')),
		backPending,
		title: computed(
			() =>
				state.value.sessions.find((s) => s.id === state.value.selected)?.title ??
				i18n.t('app.templates.chat.selectTitle')
		),
		tools: computed(() => state.value.messages.filter((m) => m.role === 'tool')),
		focusComposer: () => composer.value?.focus(),
		stop: controller.stop,
		reset: controller.reset
	};
}
